name: Gentoo
summary: Gentoo forbids contributing any content, including code, documentation, issues, comments and other text, that was created with the assistance of natural-language AI tools. Packaging AI-related software, or software developed with AI upstream, is explicitly not prohibited.

evidence.quote: It is expressly forbidden to contribute to Gentoo any content that has been created with the assistance of Natural Language Processing artificial intelligence tools.

It does not prohibit adding packages for AI-related software or software that is being developed with the help of such tools upstream.
